_about: Copy this file to lbp-config.json (gitignored) and replace every placeholder with a path on your machine. Any key can instead be set with the environment variable LBP_<KEY> (upper case, e.g. LBP_CAMPAIGN_ROOT), which overrides the file. Keys starting with an underscore are comments. 'host' paths are paths on the machine that runs the tools (JSON needs backslashes doubled); 'wsl' paths are as seen from inside WSL and are pasted into sh command lines, so $HOME is allowed. Check the result with: python tools/lbpconfig.py check
_campaign_root: host. Campaign directory with ledger/campaign.json (the function list and load segments of each module) and inputs/revision-selection.json (where your own decrypted retail modules live). The exact-match tools read retail bytes through it. Used by lbpmatch, lbpdiff, lbpdis, lbpcov, lbpclone, lbpfamilies, lbpgen, lbpqueue, lbptmpl, lbplib, lbpsample.
_pspdev_bin: wsl. Directory inside WSL with the PSPDEV binutils psp-ld, psp-objcopy and psp-objdump. lbpmatch links and extracts with them; lbpdiff disassembles with them.
_mwcc_native: wsl. Directory inside WSL, on the native Linux filesystem (not /mnt/c), holding the wibo binary and builds/<build>/mwccpsp.exe (mwccpsp 3.0.1 build 219 is builds/219/mwccpsp.exe).
_gcc_home: wsl. Directory inside WSL with the decomp.me Sony psp-gcc kits: psp-gcc-1.3.1/ and psp-gcc-1.7.1/ (needed by sources whose header says cc=gcc131-* or cc=gcc171-*; the kits are 32-bit Linux programs and need libc6-i386).
_newlib_home: wsl. Directory inside WSL with the newlib source trees <version>/newlib-<version>/newlib and the generated include directories inc-<version>. Only lbpnewlib.py (library reconstruction) needs it.
_newlib_obj_root: host. Host-visible path of the library objects built from newlib, one directory per configuration such as 1.14.0-171-O2. Only lbplib.py index needs it. From Windows a WSL directory is \\wsl.localhost\<distribution>\home\<user>\...
_nakagawa_root: host. Optional: a checkout of Nakagawa Recomp; its runtime is the platform layer of the port milestones (lbpmilestones.py reads tools/import_audit_baseline.json).
_mwcc_builds_dir: host. Directory with the decomp.me mwccpsp builds as <build>/mwccpsp.exe. lbpsample.py records the digest of the build in its manifest; nothing else needs it.
_wibo_exe: host. The wibo binary (the host copy of the one in mwcc_native); lbpsample.py records its digest.
_ghidra_headless: host. Ghidra's support/analyzeHeadless.bat. Only ghidra/run_commit_decompile.ps1 needs it.
_java_home: host. The JDK that Ghidra runs on. Only ghidra/run_commit_decompile.ps1 needs it.
_ghidra_allegrex: host. The ghidra-allegrex processor extension directory; ghidra/import_module.ps1 copies it once into the gitignored ghidra/settings/.
_hst_root: host. Optional, read-only: a checkout of hst-decomp; lbpxclone.py uses its exact sources as exemplars for shared SDK and library code.
_hst_campaign_root: host. Optional, read-only: hst-decomp's campaign directory (ledger/campaign.json, inputs/revision-selection.json), for HST's retail bytes.
_snc_home: host. Directory of the SN Systems SNC kit for PSP (decomp.me pspsnc_1.2.7503.0); sources with cc=snc127-* compile with its pspsnc.exe natively.
_gcc4_home: wsl. Directory with the open-source GCC 4.x PSP cross compilers built by build_gcc4_psp.sh (psp-gcc-4.1.0s/, psp-gcc-4.3.2/); profiles gcc410-*, gcc432-*.
_decryptor: host. The PSP game decryptor script tools/lbpintake.py runs on your own disc image (read-only; it writes the decrypted modules under the gitignored inputs/). Only lbpintake.py needs it.
